title: ADR-0053 Phase 2 · Slice 4: render datetime in reference timezone (formatters + email)
body:
**Part of ADR-0053 Phase 2.** Design: #1975 · Parent: #1928.

**Slice 4 of 6 — render-tz.** Show `datetime` instants in the reference timezone at the presentation boundary. Storage stays UTC.

### Scope
- **Centralized path (low blast radius):** the template engine `date`/`datetime` formatters already take `locale` from `EvalContext` — add a `timeZone` option to their `Intl.DateTimeFormat` calls — `packages/formula/src/template-engine.ts:88-106` (locale plumbing at `:233-236`).
- **Outlier (architectural):** email templates **bypass the formatter pipeline entirely** — `renderTemplate` does naive `String()` with no formatter/locale/tz — `packages/plugins/plugin-email/src/email-service.ts:336-340` and `plugin-email`'s `template-engine.ts`. Route email rendering through the formula template engine (or port the formatters). This is the real cost of this slice — not a parameter add.

### Acceptance criteria
- [ ] `{{ value | datetime }}` renders in the reference tz when set; UTC when unset.
- [ ] An email template containing a datetime renders in the reference tz (not raw UTC/ISO).
- [ ] `date` (calendar-day) rendering is unaffected (already tz-naive after Phase 1).

### Depends on
Slice 1 (timezone value).
